The '''Promised Vengeance of Exar Kun''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] who was an unwilling follower of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. A powerful disciple, Promised Vengeance was specially trained to dominate others with his vast knowledge of the Dark Side.

==History==
Before becoming an unwilling follower of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], the Promised Vengeance of Exar Kun was a student at [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]], trained in the histories of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. He may have been a member of an archaeological expedition on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] that unknowingly tunneled into the tombs below the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] and released the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] spirit. The evil spirit proceeded to bind the students and researchers to his will, and induct them into the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. Afterward, the spirit of Kun sent them to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], to the [[Corellia University research outpost]] they had originally come from to enslave the rest of the people there. The majority of them were then sent back to Yavin 4. After losing contact with the outpost and fearing the worst, Professor [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]] hired a group of spacers to travel to Talus and investigate. The spacers learned what had transpired and informed the professor. He provided them with the coordinates to the tomb and implored them to destroy the evil Sith Lord's spirit within. Promised Vengeance was among the dark [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] that confronted the spacers before they were able to get to the spirit of Exar Kun. However, the spacers managed to defeat all former students, and then proceed to confront the Dark Lord himself.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateExarKunCultist.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Every possible depiction of the Promised Vengeance of Exar Kun in ''Star Wars Galaxies'']]
The Promised Vengeance of Exar Kun was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Promised Vengeance was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

Because the Promised Vengeance of Exar Kun appeared in the game as a generic Exar Kun cultist, the gender and appearance of this character were randomized during each server reset.<ref name="SWG:EK" />
